media.alt: AKUH opens physiotherapy clinic on M.A. Jinnah Road

content.text: Building on an outreach programme that aims to provide accessible, compassionate and high-quality care to patients all over Karachi, Aga Khan University Hospital (AKUH) is now offering off-site physiotherapy and rehabilitation services in the heart of the old city. The new clinic, which opened last month, is part of the Hospital's Integrated Medical Services (IMS) unit on M.A. Jinnah Road and follows the successful launch of similar services at Clifton Medical Services and Aga Khan Diagnostic and Surgery Centre in Karimabad.

Supervised by a skilled therapist, the M.A. Jinnah Road clinic provides comprehensive, state-of-the-art physiotherapy and rehabilitation services for orthopaedic, neurological and paediatric conditions. In addition to its on-site physiotherapy facilities on Stadium Road, AKUH has also been offering Home-Based Physiotherapy Services for the last four years. This cost-effective, time-saving and relatively risk-free facility brings physiotherapy services to patients' doorsteps, enhancing independent function in the context of home and community living.

"The long-term plan is to introduce a multidisciplinary rehabilitation approach with state-of-the-art therapeutic modalities and techniques at the Physiotherapy Clinic at M.A. Jinnah Road," said Nasrullah Shaikh, Manager Physiotherapy Services, AKUH.
